Select distinct compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles for molecules tested in assays against target CHEMBL3880. Join target_dictionary to assays on tid, filter assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Join assays to activities on assay_id, then activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno for compound_chembl_id, then to compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Return distinct rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles.
